obligations.title: Deliver written monthly service report by the 5th business day of each month.
Provide Arcadia an annual SOC 2 Type II report and remediate material exceptions.
Maintain a written information security programme with administrative, technical and physical safeguards.
Notify Arcadia of security incidents without undue delay and cooperate in investigation and mitigation.
Return or securely delete Arcadia Data on expiry, termination or request.
Deliver all completed and in-progress Deliverables and provide transition assistance on termination.
